detail.longDescription:
Network Analyzer is an advanced network tool designed as Wi-Fi analyzer, Wi-Fi scanner, network scanner, Wi-Fi speed test, internet speed test and port scanner to troubleshoot and improve network security, connectivity issues and performances. It also offers a wide range of features to assist in diagnosing the problems within your office and home Wi-Fi/local network, router, Internet connection and even on remote servers. All the Key features include:


Network Information:

- Current connection with default gateway, HTTP Proxy, Public IP, DNS server(s), ISP name
- Provides Wi-Fi information & analysis with network details (SSID, BSSID, vendor, IP address, IPv6 address, subnet mask, broadcast, Wi-Fi security type, Wi-Fi channel and bandwidth)
- Shows cell/mobile network information (network type, IP Address, IPv6 address, subnet mask)
- Shows vpn and hotspot network information
- Internet Information (AS Number, AS Name, Public Address, Hostname, Time Zone, Location with MAP)
- Monitors Wi-Fi, cellular, vpn & hotspot data usage
- Network Interface of your device
- Real time internet speed meter


Wi-Fi Signal Scanner:

- Wi-Fi frequencies (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz)
- Nearby network with channels and signal strengths
- Wi-Fi network types (WEP, WPA, WPA2)
- Wi-Fi encryption methods (AES, TKIP)
- BSSID (MAC address), MAC Vendor
- Network bandwidth
- Wi-Fi Standards


Device Discovery (LAN / IP Scanner):

- Wi-Fi analyzer and Scanner to detect all online devices connected to the network
- Provides IP addresses of all detected devices
- Identifies mDNS (Bonjour), netBIOS, UPnP and DNS names where available
- Conducts ping tests on discovered devices
- Device details (Manage device, Local service discovery and Network details)
- Wi-Fi Network details (Access points, Network setup)
- Discover online devices in home and office Wi-Fi network


Network Tools:

Our advanced network tools are used to verify internet performance, improve network security, troubleshoot and monitor network and more -

- Internet speed test / Wi-Fi speed test
- DNS Speed Test
- BLE devices / Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Scanner
- Ping
- Wake on LAN (WOL)
- Whois
- Traceroute (Including Visual Trace)
- Find open ports
- Router vulnerability
- Privacy Analyzer
- SSL Certificate Checker
- IP Address Lookup
- DNS Lookup (A, AAAA, CAA, MX,NS, TXT more)
- MAC Address Lookup (Including MAC address, OUI and Vendor name)


Local Service Discovery:

- Bonjour services browser
- UPnP services and device browser


More Features:

- Light & Dark Appearance
- Full IPv6 Support
- Optimized for Phone & Tablet


Network Analyzer: WiFi Scanner is an essential net tools and network analyzer for anyone looking forward to managing and troubleshooting their network efficiently.
